_meta.scope: Coc dong chiu nen doc truc — phan tich tinh hoc theo dat nen (Dieu 7.3.8.6)

nordlund_thurman_sand.applies_to: cat, cat bot khong pha set

SPT_meyerhof_sand.applies_to: cat, cat bot khong pha set

static_test_plus_dynamic_2pct.condition: Thu tai tinh >= 1 coc + thu dong >= 2 coc (>= 2% tong so coc)

static_test_only.condition: Thu tai tinh >= 1 coc, khong thu dong

dynamic_signal_matching_2pct.condition: Thu dong tuong hop tin hieu >= 2 coc (>= 2%), kiem soat chat luong

wave_equation_only.condition: Phuong trinh song, theo doi hieu suat bua tai hien truong

FHWA_dynamic_formula.condition: Cong thuc dong Gate hieu chinh boi FHWA (EOD)

ENR_formula.condition: Cong thuc ENR moi (New Engineering Record) — EOD

parameters.Su: Suc khang cat khong thoat nuoc (MPa)
parameters.alpha: He so ket dinh — tra theo bieu do Tomlinson (1980), Hinh 18

alpha_tomlinson_1980.description: Noi suy tuyen tinh tu bieu do Hinh 18
alpha_tomlinson_1980.note: Ap dung cho coc dong vao tang dat set

parameters.sigma_v_eff: Ung suat co hieu thang dung (MPa)
parameters.beta: He so — tra theo bieu do Hinh 19 (Esrig & Kirby 1979) theo OCR

parameters.sigma_v_eff: Ung suat co hieu thang dung tai diem giua lop dat (MPa)
parameters.Su: Suc khang cat khong thoat nuoc (MPa)
parameters.lambda: He so thuc nghiem — tra theo Hinh 20 (Vijayvergiya & Focht 1972)

nordlund_thurman_sand.soil_type: cat, cat bot khong pha set, soi cuoi

formula.skin_friction: qs = K_delta * CF * sigma_v_eff * sin(delta + omega) / cos(omega)

parameters.K_delta: He so ap luc dat nam ngang — tra Hinh 21-24 theo phi_f
parameters.CF: He so dieu chinh K_delta khi delta != phi_f — tra Hinh 25
parameters.sigma_v_eff: Ung suat co hieu tang phu phia tren tai diem giua lop (MPa); <= 0.15 MPa cho mui coc
parameters.delta: Goc ma sat giua coc va dat — tra Hinh 26 (do)
parameters.omega: Goc nghieng coc so voi phuong thang dung (do); = 0 cho coc thang dung
parameters.N_q_prime: He so kha nang chiu luc — tra Hinh 28
parameters.qL: Suc khang don vi chan coc gioi han — tra Hinh 29 (MPa)

SPT_meyerhof_sand.soil_type: cat, cat bot khong pha set

formula.tip_limit_silty_sand: lambda_q = 6 * 0.3 * N160 = 1.8 * N160  (MPa) — cho cat bot
formula.skin_displacement: qs = 0.0019 * N160   (MPa) — coc chiem cho (dac, hop kin)
formula.skin_nondisplacement: qs = 0.00096 * N160  (MPa) — coc khong chiem cho (chu H)

parameters.N160: So bua SPT hieu chinh theo ap luc tang phu (bua/300mm) — Dieu 4.6.2.4
parameters.D: Be rong hoac duong kinh coc (mm)
parameters.Db: Chieu dai coc ngam trong tang dat chiu luc (mm)

pile_types.displacement: Mat cat dac hoac hop mui coc kin (beton duc san, coc ong bit day)
pile_types.non_displacement: Mat cat thanh mong mui ho, khong tao loi nem dat (coc chu H)

CPT_nottingham_schmertmann.soil_type: cat, cat bot khong pha set

formula.qc1: Trung binh qc trong khoang 0.7D den 4.0D duoi mui coc — dung quy tac duong toi thieu
formula.qc2: Trung binh qc trong khoang 8D tren mui coc — dung quy tac duong toi thieu
formula.skin_friction: Rs = Ks_c * SUM(fsi * asi * hi) (N)  — Pt. 72
formula.Ks_c: He so chinh sua — Kc cho dat set, Ks cho cat — tra Hinh 31

design_flow.step1: Xac dinh loai dat theo tuyen coc (set / cat / hon hop)
design_flow.step2: Chon phuong phap phan tich (alpha, beta, lambda, Nordlund, SPT, CPT)
design_flow.step3: Tinh Rs (ma sat thanh ben) theo tung lop dat
design_flow.step6: Chon phi_stat tu Bang 9 theo phuong phap da dung
design_flow.step7: RR = phi_sta * Rn >= luc tinh toan tac dung len coc (co he so)
design_flow.step8: Kiem tra kha nang dong coc: ung suat dong coc, so bua, he so phi_dyn
